verdict.rationale: GitLab documents self-managed installation through the Linux package, official Docker images, Helm chart/Operator, or self-compiling, so a user can host GitLab, and therefore its data, wherever they choose. That residency control is implied by self-hosting rather than documented as a region/residency feature. One community comment mentions GitLab data centers in Asia and Europe, but it is about speed, not choosing a storage region. Missing for 10: documented region/data-residency selection for the hosted GitLab.com offering, explicit residency guarantees for AI/Duo Agent Platform data, independent corroboration of residency controls.
